verdict.rationale: Retell documents official Node.js/Python SDKs with typed clients and full endpoint coverage, a CLI for managing resources from the terminal, and API references (e.g., clone-voice endpoint) — and a runtime probe confirms the CLI installs/runs keylessly and the hosted MCP server exposes the entire API via meta-tools, proving the API is genuinely agent-drivable. Missing for 10: a publicly discoverable OpenAPI/swagger spec (all standard paths returned 404 in the probe).
